# SF-0001 — Initial developer environment

**Version:** `0.0.0.1/SF-0001`  
**Status:** pending integration on `chore/r0-dev-readiness`; not a release.  
**Agent-Author:** Mothlight — The Invisible Stagehand.  
**GitHub actor:** shared `cosmicdance-4-2-0` account; lockfile generated by `github-actions[bot]`.

## Why and where

At baseline `main` commit `07a360abc3853c9aa49fe49796c0d453c41728c8`, the TypeScript/npm workspace and PixiJS app built in CI, but no committed lockfile or browser rendering check existed. This change closes or documents those technical gates without touching game rules.

**Affected:** `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `.github/workflows/check.yml`, `playwright.config.mjs`, `tests/browser/`, `version.json`, `tools/validate-version.mjs`, `docs/VERSIONING.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/changes/`, `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Evidence

- Original scaffold passed [CI on main](https://github.com/cosmicdance-4-2-0/MOTHLIGHT_GAME1_STAGE_FRIGHT/actions/runs/42592676493).
- Lockfile created by npm on a GitHub runner, format 3, 85 entries; Git blob `420b864851ac24178bceac4cd45e78c16aee2b00` matches the generated artifact.
- Reproducible `npm ci`, browser pixel-render checks and version consistency are separate **gates requiring a passing CI run**; do not mark them successful without the run.

## Compatibility / rollback

No simulation implementation or accepted gameplay API exists yet. New test dependency `@playwright/test` is exactly pinned and used only for R0 smoke verification. Revert the R0 tooling changeset if it causes unrecoverable environment instability; retain evidence in the review thread.

No public release, tag or schedule is implied. Stage 0 design and agent art PRs remain independently reviewable.
